current_activity: SBDs from Henderson Field damage destroyer Umikaze on a resupply run
notes: Cressman, 24 September 1942: SBDs (VMSB 231, VS 3) from Henderson Field, Guadalcanal, damage Japanese destroyer Umikaze during resupply operations. First dated Henderson detachment of VS 3 in the pages read (Saratoga had been torpedoed on 31 August). Confidence 0.5 (single us_navy_nhhc family). current_activity: SBDs from Henderson Field join the attack that leaves Murakumo to be scuttled
notes: Cressman, 12 October 1942: after being damaged by TBF (VT 8), Navy and Marine SBDs (VS 3, VS 71, VMSB 141) and Marine F4Fs off New Georgia, Murakumo is scuttled by Shirayuki. VS 3 is also named from Henderson on 3 and 5 October in the same chronology. Confidence 0.5 (single us_navy_nhhc family). Branch guadalcanal-carrier-air-missions, 26 November 2026.
